title: CLAIR-Fin: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Framework for Claim-Level Verification and Adaptive Debate in Cross-Modal Financial QA
abstract: arXiv:2608.13706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing defenses against hallucination in retrieval-augmented and multi-agent pipelines remain partial: evidence is trusted despite modality disagreement, debate verifies an aggregate report rather than individual claims, and such verification occurs only after drafting, leaving inter-agent errors undetected until the final text. To close this gap, we present CLAIR-Fin, a nine-agent framework that decomposes each question into atomic claims maintained in a typed Financial Claim Ledger. translated_title: CLAIR-Fin：一种用于跨模态金融问答中声明级验证与自适应辩论的对抗性多智能体框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13706v1 公告类型：跨领域 摘要：现有针对检索增强和多智能体管线中幻觉的防御仍不完善：证据即使存在模态分歧也被信任，辩论验证的是汇总报告而非单个声明，且此类验证仅在草拟之后进行，导致智能体间错误直到最终文本才被发现。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出CLAIR-Fin，一个九智能体框架，将每个问题分解为原子声明，并维护在类型化金融声明账本中。每个声明通过非对称证据权威来解决，该机制根据声明类型调节证据信任度，而非将所有模态视为同等可靠；通过监管链验证，在草拟与对抗性审查交接时检查依据，而非仅在管线出口；通过自适应反驳循环，将争议声明路由至对抗性辩论，其深度随辩论发现而扩展；以及一个te
tldr: CLAIR-Fin通过九智能体框架将金融问题分解为原子声明，并利用类型化证据信任、交接时验证和自适应深度辩论，首次在声明级别实现跨模态金融问答的幻觉防御。
en_tdlr: CLAIR-Fin, a nine-agent framework, decomposes financial questions into atomic claims with typed evidence trust, hand-off verification, and adaptive-depth adversarial debate, achieving claim-level hallucination defense in cross-modal financial QA for the first time.
